title: Nx Plugin V2 And Atomic Custom Plugin Relocation
description:
This is step M2 of the "mechanism wave" (W4) in the approved plan `/Users/ueli/.claude/plans/the-codebase-still-has-spicy-umbrella.md` — read it in full first, especially "Mechanism changes" Step 2 and the M2 bullet under "W4 — Mechanism wave", plus "Hard ordering constraints" C2 ("M2 before W9 sweep; .mjs destination final") and Top risk #3 ("nx.json/.mjs atomicity failure kills the nx graph → solo agent, one edit, in-run nx graph smoke, standby fix"). THIS IS EXPLICITLY FLAGGED AS THE SINGLE RISKIEST ATOM IN THE ENTIRE MULTI-WEEK PLAN — read that risk section carefully and follow its mitigation exactly.

CONTEXT — read in full, in this order:
1. The spicy-umbrella plan file above.
2. `.🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️08/☀️05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️master.md` — the master tracking doc for the whole initiative, read in FULL for prior lessons and current state (all 32 plugins + demonstrator done; M1's taxonomy vocabulary/discovery library just landed at `🧰️framework/🛍️products/🦑️repo/🔨️modules/📚️lib/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript/{🔣️taxonomy.json,🟦️discovery.ts}` — you may read and reference these but the registry/root-policy refactors that consume them are separate future tickets, not yours).
3. `nx.json` at repo root — find the two custom nx plugin `.mjs` files it references by literal path.
4. The two `.mjs` files themselves, read in full.

YOUR TASK: 
1. Default project `cwd` to the project root and default executor where the current nx plugin logic doesn't already do this cleanly; synthesize the "leveled test targets" convention consistently (read existing project.json files to understand today's convention before changing anything).
2. Move BOTH custom nx plugin `.mjs` files to their FINAL destination in the repo-product's `📚️lib/` owner root (this must be the location W8d's future Go-split work will also use — check the plan's W8d section for what that owner-root path will eventually be, and land the .mjs files there now so they never move again).
3. Update `nx.json`'s literal path reference(s) to the new location IN THE SAME ATOMIC CHANGE — never leave nx.json pointing at a stale path even transiently.
4. Immediately after the move+repoint, run `bun nx show projects | wc -l` and compare the count to what it was BEFORE your change (capture the before-count first, as your very first action, before touching anything) — if it changes even slightly, STOP, treat it as a red alert, and diagnose/fix before doing anything else (do not proceed to other work with a broken nx graph). Also run `bun nx graph --file=/dev/null` or equivalent to confirm the graph itself still resolves.
5. Delete any dead duplicate function you find in the nx plugin files (the plan mentions one exists) — confirm it's actually dead (no call sites) before removing.
6. nx.json hygiene: remove the stale `cpp` namedInput glob if you confirm it's unused, and check `workspaceLayout` for correctness against the new .mjs location.

CONSTRAINTS (non-negotiable):
- This is a SOLO task — do not parallelize sub-pieces, since a broken nx.json mid-edit would corrupt everyone else's tooling. Make the .mjs move + nx.json repoint as ONE atomic edit sequence with the verification smoke test immediately after, before moving to any other step.
- Never touch root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, registry generated output, .vscode/launch.json, package.json workspaces, .storybook, .dependency-cruiser.cjs, any plugin directory, or the taxonomy vocabulary/discovery files from M1 (read-only for you).
- Never run git-modifying commands or use git worktrees.
- Do NOT use `run_in_background: true` for Bash — run synchronously with generous timeouts.
- If the project count changes or the graph fails to resolve after your edit, immediately revert your own edit (you may edit files you just created/moved — this is not a git revert, just undoing your own uncommitted change) and re-diagnose before retrying. Do not leave the nx graph broken under any circumstance, even temporarily across tool calls in this session.
- Add temporary files to your own ticket folder.
- When finished (nx graph verified healthy), call `mcp__repo__ticket_close` on your own ticket's exact path with a full summary and file list. Do not touch any other ticket.

Report back a concise summary of what moved, the before/after project counts, and graph-health verification.
